استفتين (form X)

# اُسْتُفْتِينَ (ustuftīna) /us.tuf.tiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَفْتَى (istaftā)
# اِسْتَفْتِينَ (istaftīna) /is.taf.tiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَفْتَى (istaftā)
